decision.observation: Car at 0 mph for the second frame running, at the right edge of the lane with a large pine close on its right. Red X lit, all dots dark. Lane runs up-screen past puddles on the left and bends right near the top. Spectator figures stand on the lower-left verge.
decision.hypothesis: A 1.0s throttle hold produced no movement, so the car is probably pinned against the pine or a post on its right rather than stalled in a puddle. Reversing should free it before steering left onto open tarmac.
decision.memory: Two 0 mph frames after a full 1.0s W hold, with no puddle under the car, means a pin. Use the S 1.0s recovery.
